extra.final_summary: The data had several issues affecting the analysis: 1) 'body_mass_g' was stored as text with commas; fixed by casting to numeric. 2) One row had a negative flipper length (-181 mm), which is below the allowed minimum of 170 mm; excluded. 3) Three rows had body mass values over 6,500 grams (up to 5,950,000 g), which are clearly erroneous; excluded. 4) One 'sex' label was 'FEMALE' (uppercase); normalized to 'female'. 5) One exact duplicate row was removed. After these fixes, the total body mass for each species was calculated: Adelie: 108,975 g, Chinstrap: 37,725 g, Gentoo: 98,350 g.
